title: 100421-G-XXXXA-001 Coast Guard films fire while searching for survivors from burning oil drilling platform
description: NEW ORLEANS - A Coast Guard MH-65C rescue helicopter and crew from Coast Guard Air Station New Orleans films a fire aboard the mobile offshore drilling unit (MODU) Deepwater Horizon, while searching for survivors April 21, 2010. Multiple Coast Guard helicopters, planes and cutters are responding to rescue 126 people after the Coast Guard eighth district command center received a report that the Deepwater Horizon had experienced an explosion at approximately 10 p.m. April 20, 2010. U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 2nd Class Scott Lloyd.
